body: I’ll be leading a discussion on faith, values and politics – this Monday, October 13th, at 12 p.m. at the Anderson City Hall Auditorium, 120 East 8th Street – Anderson, IN. The event is in support of the Barack Obama campaign … If you know folks in the area who might want to come, would you spread the word? Thanks!
